description.value: Cue's N Cushion is a family-owned social entertainment lounge open since 2022 in Tsawwassen (Delta), BC, combining pool tables, darts, board games, air hockey, arcade games, and ping pong with a Mediterranean-inspired kitchen serving snacks, meals, specialty coffees, and milkshakes. The venue runs a packed weekly events calendar—movie nights, pool training sessions, UFC screenings, and fundraiser events—and can host private or corporate groups with full-lounge buyouts. A touring cyclist would find a lively, welcoming stop with real food and a range of beverages in a purpose-built community hub.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 15m; stands (4 spaces) at 92m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and active (events calendar shows June 2026 listings, 'WE ARE OPEN NOW' banner), confirming the business is real and currently operating. The website confirms the OSM phone number (1-866-412-7266), address (1244 56th Street, Delta, BC, V4L 2A4), and Mediterranean cuisine tag. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, and most cyclist amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the site, so those are null; however, DoorDash and 'Order Online' navigation links confirm takeout availability, and 'Veggie Dog' appears explicitly on the published menu as a vegetarian item.
concerns: OSM tags this as amenity=cafe, but the business is primarily a gaming and entertainment lounge with a café component — the tag is a loose fit, though Food & Drink remains the appropriate directory category.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible venue with food and beverage service in Tsawwassen; a legitimate rest and meal stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: 'Veggie Dog' explicitly listed on the published menu as a standalone item
